name: Monitoring and Controlling
excerpt: Monitoring and Controlling involves expert judgement and earned value management.
notes: Monitoring and Controlling is a key concept in project management, involving the use of expert judgement and tools like Earned Value Management to measure project performance based on scope, schedule, and cost.
